Burnaby real estate market stats for September 2026: benchmark prices and trends
Burnaby houses by price band, September 2026

50 houses sold in September against 458 listed. The price band with the most sales was $1,500,001 to $1,750,000, with 14 sold (28% of the month). Among bands with at least ten homes listed, the highest sales ratio was $1,250,001 to $1,500,000 at 18%.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Bands with nothing listed and nothing sold are left out. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Burnaby houses: 13 months of listings, sales and prices to September 2026

Over the 13 months from September 2025 to September 2026, listings of houses in Burnaby peaked at 477 in June 2026 and bottomed at 303 in December 2025. Sales were strongest in June 2026 with 57. The reported sale price moved from $1,987,500 to $1,825,000, a change of −8.2%.
